summary: Issue #1751, walk of the GOD_4 prima via route (root 8626f8a5, argument ed7c588a) until its premises bottom out, lane B. The sixteen open leaves of the cheapest expansion that concern existential dependence, simple priority and grounding were reassessed under current standards at main df4909cb025d2e53fee6071a32defe9cf2721284 (GOD_4 root: 423 open premises, 84 current, 158 legacy-only, 181 none; of the sixteen, nine legacy-only and seven none). Read: sections 1-8 of docs/notes/causal-dependence-support-investigation.md; sections 1-3 of priority-independence-logic-support-investigation.md; distinct-dependence-strict-ground-route.md whole; the heater test and judgment of causal-transitivity-1399.md; the D sense table of god-existence-support-formula.md; the rivals of borrowed-exercise-741.md; the lect. 13 section of docs/power-existence-scope-boundary.md; legacy attempts 0daeaa81, 56ae2547, a739dad6, 1020b663, f798617c, 5cf65146, 63e65ca6, a4d430a0, 040e3b4e, 7b8e8975, finite-ancestry-no-loops-regress, pruss-koons-finite-history-reading, rival-sourcing-papineau-hume-512 and the two rejected-edge attempts; current attempt dd24400b; the Lean definitions of all sixteen and the Challenge types of every consuming argument on the route; dossier, currentness, tree and semantics for each. The route enters the sixteen through three spines: the per se regress for c1b68c21 (c0d99549, fea5942a, 42756c07, 000e1f65, 97fa3a0b, d85de8e1, 47aff057, 09b88101, f10d5632, with 8ab3d114), uniqueness via the maximum in being (3ef67739, 2e248016, 71454b27, d6e558d0, 57c5ed67, 47aff057, 402cf70f), and pure act via the first being (47aff057, 5dacb0db). End states: derivable 1 (f10d5632, by selecting the studied relation); reducible 1 (fea5942a: with 42756c07, for the selected S built from distinct-step D, equivalent to the open 702dc502, one direction e86849cf, the converse proposed); defended primitive or direct option 5 (97fa3a0b on concrete relata, 71454b27, d6e558d0, 57c5ed67, 5dacb0db); open with a named blocker 9 (c0d99549, 42756c07, 000e1f65, d85de8e1, 47aff057, 09b88101, 3ef67739, 2e248016, 402cf70f). Analyst observations, unregistered and not Lean-checked: D, W and P are Lean parameters and no bridge is a meaning postulate of the records, but irreflexivity of CanBeWithout is one, and the bridges make W the complement of D and P the strict part of D; 97f5850f follows from 42890b45 and f10d5632 by subrelation, which removes 6009e16f, 09b88101 and finite ancestry; e078f07b has a stating claim (3ed048c0), and taking it directly removes c0d99549, fea5942a and 42756c07, and together with the 97f5850f bypass also 000e1f65, 97fa3a0b and 8ab3d114; 8ab3d114, irreflexive W, 2e248016 and 402cf70f (or 98efaa9e) are jointly inconsistent with any actual concretum under the route's single interpretation of D, W, m and w, without excluded middle; c0d99549 follows from e078f07b and the forward half of 47aff057; simple priority is used both as priority in act in a respect (the gloss of 1d9aa4d9, carried by a4d3261a and by e078f07b's all-respects quantifier) and as priority in being (47aff057, 97fa3a0b, 5dacb0db, the uses that depart from the definition), and the hand and the stick separate the two; on either single reading of P, d85de8e1 with all-respects e078f07b faces an established counterexample (row 1 on priority in being, row 21 on priority in causing), so e229bb2c is not a surviving support for 42890b45 unless e078f07b is restricted to per se ordered causing. Lane A's reciprocity case was checked against the Lean declarations: the derivation is valid; on the priority-in-causing reading it refutes the respect-free order laws joined with all-respects e078f07b, on the priority-in-being reading all-respects e078f07b itself. Objections: kept 11; restated 3; boundaries retained 3; one scope condition; one row of non-objections; no substantive objection identified 2. The truth semantics preflight on the thirteen consuming route arguments reports no unbridged mixing, only allowlisted legacy mixings (ancestry mixings not assessed), and treats SIMPLY_PRIOR_1 as one sense. Record defect noted: definition c86cc1d1 describes ActualConcreteGround but names GroundAncestor. Countermodels are restated as facts about single interpretations. One judgment is revised (c0d99549); a formal revisions declaration is deferred while #1757 is open. Independent semantic challenge of bfadeef51: accept after repairs; repairs applied. No theorem, Challenge, claim, statement, definition, relation, closure or formal status changed.
blocker: Open: the originating/sustaining fork of DependsForBeing (#1626) for 000e1f65, 2e248016 and 3ef67739; the diagonal fork of D (reflexive or strict) for 3ef67739, 5dacb0db and the inconsistent package with 8ab3d114; the respect fork in SIMPLY_PRIOR_1 (priority in act in a respect versus priority in being), unregistered, for 47aff057, c0d99549, d85de8e1 and e078f07b; the per se regress premise against the source-free infinitist structure; the dependence principle for contingent concreta (3ef67739) against existential inertia; the interpretation of the PLG atoms for 42756c07; the cross-world export of 402cf70f. Next test: bind spine I to 97f5850f directly, or to an e078f07b restricted to per se ordered causing, and not to respect-free d85de8e1.

current_assessment.scope: Lane B of the #1751 bottom-out walk: the sixteen open leaves of the cheapest expansion of the GOD_4 prima via route (argument ed7c588a) that concern existential dependence, simple priority and grounding, in three spines: the per se regress for c1b68c21, uniqueness via the maximum in being for c27dce66, and pure act via the first being for 6c18d52b. 8ab3d114 is used as assessed in dd24400b and not reassessed. The motion and causal-chain core of lane A (57552dce and others) is named as a shared dependency and not assessed.
current_assessment.assessment: Under the fixed meanings (counterfactual D with its diagonal and originating/sustaining forks open; W as real possibility of being without, irreflexive by its own words; P a world-free, respect-free primitive glossed by act and potency; E here-and-now efficient causing in any respect; world-free CausesIn at esse; world-local selected grounds) the sixteen end as follows. Derivable: f10d5632 (true by selecting the studied relation, its content moving to 57552dce of lane A). Reducible: fea5942a (with 42756c07, for the selected S built from distinct-step D, equivalent to the open 702dc502; one direction e86849cf, the converse proposed). Defended primitive or direct option: 97fa3a0b on concrete relata (n. 15 criterion, transport to P open), 71454b27 (q.44 a.1 ad 2), d6e558d0 and 57c5ed67 (domain stipulations), 5dacb0db (close to a meaning postulate of D read with its agent-cause clause). Open with a named blocker: c0d99549 (kept counterexample: the hand moving the stick and the heater heating water are efficient causings in a respect without existential dependence), 42756c07 (trivial under the fea5942a selection; for an independently specified existence-fact theory, uninterpreted atoms), 000e1f65 (strong prima facie on the sustaining reading, the living-parent case on the originating one), d85de8e1 (load-bearer of spine I as expanded; infinitist rival kept, and joined with all-respects e078f07b on the causing reading, the kept counterexample of row 21), 47aff057 (sound on priority in being, but on the route it shares one P with e078f07b's priority in act in a respect), 09b88101 (dispensable on the route), 3ef67739 (trivial on reflexive D, contested by existential inertia on strict sustaining D), 2e248016 (avoidable by a8298fbd except in dd7ee4b9) and 402cf70f (cross-world export, conditional on reading CausesIn as actual causing; avoidable by 98efaa9e). Analyst observations, unregistered and not Lean-checked: 8ab3d114, irreflexive W, 2e248016 and 402cf70f or 98efaa9e exclude every actual concretum under the route's single interpretation, without excluded middle; c0d99549 follows from e078f07b and the forward half of 47aff057; 97f5850f follows from 42890b45 and f10d5632; taking e078f07b on its stating claim 3ed048c0 removes c0d99549, fea5942a and 42756c07, and with the 97f5850f bypass also 000e1f65, 97fa3a0b and 8ab3d114. Overall: a positively motivated conditional structure whose recorded form needs two sense fixes, strict sustaining D and a split of simple priority into priority in act in a respect and priority in being. With them, the bridges 000e1f65, 47aff057, 97fa3a0b and 5dacb0db have strong prima facie support from In V Metaph. lect. 13 nn. 15-18, q.44 a.1 ad 2 and q.104 a.1. The load then rests on the per se regress premise 97f5850f, taken directly on its q.2 a.3 claims, against the infinitist rival. On either single reading of P, d85de8e1 with all-respects e078f07b faces an established counterexample (on priority in being, row 1 against e078f07b; on priority in causing, row 21 against d85de8e1), so e229bb2c is not a surviving support for 42890b45 unless e078f07b is restricted to per se ordered causing, in which case d85de8e1 reduces to the regress premise. The other loads are 3ef67739 against existential inertia and transport of priority in being to spine III. Lane A's reciprocity case: the derivation is valid; the fault lies in respect-free P combined with e078f07b's quantifier over every respect. Kept objections 11, restated 3, boundaries retained 3, one scope condition, no substantive objection identified 2. One judgment is revised (c0d99549); nothing is established, defeated or closed.
